What is tipster? STATSCORE’s Tipster is a state-of-the-art automated sports tips service built to significantly enhance user engagement for your sports business through data-driven sports information. This hints widget delivers sports data recommendations, contextual tips, and automated insights, covering a wide array of markets, powered by advanced mathematical models and historical data. Actionable insights provide users with pre-game and real-time information to help them identify trends and encourage making decisions before and during matches. Key features  American football Baseball Basketball Cricket Handball Ice hockey Football (soccer) Table tennis Tennis Volleyball  1X2 Under/over goals (total, home team, away team) Both teams to score First team to score Asian handicap Double chance Under/over (corners, cards, offsides, etc.) …and many more  Integrated with sportsbooks’ offerings, it inspires users to effortlessly add their selections to the betslips. This strategy enables sportsbooks to effectively attract and engage their users.  Informed by historical data and contextual statistics, Tipster covers 100 markets for pre-match and in-play scenarios. Actionable tips allow players to identify trends and make quicker decisions before and during matches.  English Chinese Hindi Spanish Arabic Brazilian French German Turkish Portuguese …and 8 more!  Flexible display options (colors, fonts, etc.) to match specific projects’ style and design. Available as a standalone widget or within LivematchPro and PrematchPro. Tipster – Latest Updates How does tipster work? Tailored for the world’s most popular sports — football, tennis, basketball, American football, cricket, volleyball, ice hockey, baseball, table tennis, and handball — Tipster is the top source of pre-match and in-play tips. This unique platform ensures your users receive the most relevant and detailed sports data hints and fully automated sports insights inspiring and encouraging them to make their decisions. Each sport features a unique set of specific markets; for instance, football comes with data-driven recommendations on 1X2, under/over goals, both teams to score, first team to score, and more! 4 Compelling display options standalone solutions or smoothly integrated into livematchpro/prematchpro widgets Tipster has been designed to seamlessly integrate with your existing sportsbook or media platform, offering a variety of customizable display options. Whether you prefer a sleek, scrollable list showcasing all tips or an in-game integration that overlays data directly on live coverage, this solution adapts to your needs and preferences. Additionally, Tipster can be combined with other widgets, such as LivematchPro and PrematchPro, to ensure a cohesive and visually appealing user experience.
